title: urn:qauth:ia:sign_in:v1-rc.0
description: A path marker (#1079), the way back from `register`: answering it turns the registration into a sign-in in the same interaction, for the same authorization request, at the sign-in’s first round: the `identifier` step, with a passkey before it while passkey sign-in is on and the realm’s upstream providers beside it. Offered as an alternative of a registration’s address step, before anyone is named and before any mailbox is proved, whether the registration began with `prompt=create` or with `register`. Nothing the registration kept carries over: the sign-in starts empty. After the mailbox is proved, an address an account holds goes on to that account’s sign-in by itself, as before. The page shows it as “I have an account”. Works without JavaScript.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
